whyNow.heading: The next horizon
whyNow.lead: In this new world, who gets to decide what comes next? Does our contribution still matter? Beneath these questions lies a familiar tension: an impulse to hold back change or try to control it.
paragraphs: Imaginal carries these questions into a future of abundance, where - even in the future - the impulse for control still remains. The tensions unfold through a human lens: a daughter stepping out of her mother’s shadow, a mother entrusting someone else with unfinished work, and a human and an AI learning to work together.

Through these relationships, the film reveals that preserving what matters can mean allowing its form to change. It does not seek to eliminate uncertainty or fight resistance. It invites audiences to recognize the priceless value of their creative agency: to imagine possibilities, contribute while remaining distinct, and harness progress to expand our sovereignty and capacity to create.
Seeing this possibility is what loosens resistance. The film makes this possibility felt.

audience.heading: Audience & positioning
audience.description: Adults ages 18–40 drawn to blockbuster adventure and provocative science fiction. They seek imaginative escapism, large-scale action and character-driven underdog stories that also explore deeper themes around power, culture and society.
